shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && echo "-----" && ls -la && git status --short

cat package.json && echo ----- && find src -type f | xargs ls -la && echo ----- && for f in src/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done; echo -----; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo -----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60; echo -----; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme RadioButton Select Segmented 2>&1 | head -120; echo -----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme RadioButton 2>&1 | head -60; echo -----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50; echo ----; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*' | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "theme" README.md | head -40; echo ----; find build/esm -name "*.d.ts" | grep -i -E "theme|RadioButton|Segmented" | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts theme/types.d.ts theme/useTheme.d.ts theme/useThemeValue.d.ts theme/ThemeContext.d.ts; echo ----; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p theme/ThemeProvider.js 2>/dev/null || ls theme

sed -n 1,200p Select/Select.d.ts | grep -n -E "interface|value|onUpdate|options|label|placeholder|size|width|multiple|disabled|title" | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -A12 "interface ControlGroupProps\|interface ControlGroupOption\|interface ControlProps" types.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; grep -n "export" Select/index.d.ts Select/*.d.ts | head -20; echo; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/package.json | grep '"version"'
sed -n 95,112p Select/types.d.ts; grep -rn "SelectOption\b" Select/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "export" Select/index.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit: $?"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
